paite: Pathian aw, bang ding a hon paimang den ding na hia oi? Bangziak a na gantatna mun a belamte tung a na hehna akhut?
heading: Asaph La / Nam Hutkhiakna Dia Thumna
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

paite: Na mite omkhawmte, nidanglai a na lei, na gou ding a na tat namte theigige in; na omna Zion tang toh.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

paite: Tangtawn siatna lam ah na khe khai in, melmate'n mun siangthou ah thil gilou chiteng ahihta uhi.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

paite: Nangmah doute na mite kikhawmte lak ah a-awng zuazua ua; achiamtehnate uh chiamtehna hi ding in atakta uhi.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

paite: Mi singbawk heipi a ngimte bang in akimu ua.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

paite: Tun ah athilkhuak kilawm teng uh heita leh sek in ahihse chiat uhi.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

paite: Na mun siangthou ahal ua; na min omna lei a tumkhop hial in ahihbuahta uhi.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

paite: Alungsim un, avek in i hihse ding, achi ua, hiai gam a Pathian kikhopna inn tengteng ahalse khinta uhi.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

paite: I kichiamtehnate uh i muta kei ua, zawlnei a-omta kei ua asawtdan ding thei himhim i lak uah leng a-om kei hi.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

paite: Pathian aw, melma in bang tan ahia hon gensiat ding? Gal in na min tangtawn in agense dia hia?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

paite: Bang ding in ahia, na khut, na khut taklam na lakkik? Pholhkhe nawn inla, amaute hihmang in.
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

paite: Himahleh, Pathian nidanglai tan a ka Kumpipa, lei laitak a hotdamna siampa pen ahi.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

paite: Nang na hatna in tuipi na kikhensak a, nang tui a dragonte na kitamsak hi.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

paite: Nang Leviathan lute na zansak a, amah gamdai mi omte kiang ah an ding in na pia hi.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

paite: Nang tuikhuk leh tui lian na khen a; nang lui lian taktakte na kangsak hi.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

paite: Sun nang a ahi a, zan leng nang а ahi. Nang khovak leh nisa na ngaihtuah hi.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

paite: Nang leitung gamgite na khung vek hi; nang nipi leh phalbi na siam ahi.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

paite: TOUPA aw, hiai theigige in, melma in ahon gensiat a; nam haipi in na min agensiat.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

paite: Aw na vakhu hinna gam sahang kiang ah pe mahmah ke'nla; na migentheite hinna tangtawn in mangngilh sam ke'n.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

paite: Thukhun hon poimohngaih in; lei mun mial tata hiamgamna omna in adim hi.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

paite: Aw, nuaisiahna thuakte zahlak in nungkik kei uhenla; genthei leh tagahte'n na min phat uhen.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

paite: Pathian aw, thou inla, nangmah thu kigen tawm inla, mihai in nitum in ahon gensiat dan theigige in.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

paite: Nangmah galte husa mangngilh ke'n; ahon sualte chiak vengvung a paitou gige ahi uhi.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
